metadata.name: Wyoming Priority Rating Model
metadata.source_citation: Wyoming Aeronautics Commission, Priority Rating Model for Project Evaluation, July 20, 2021. Encoded from source PDF at Priority_Model/Example Prioritization Models/Wyoming Prioritization Model 2021.pdf.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded Wyoming PRM 2021 as multiplicative 7-category model totaling 105 points
decisions_log.rationale: Wyoming explicitly states: 'numerical rating is assigned, and then multiplied by the category weight to determine a final category numerical value. The seven category values are then summed' — fits multiplicative weighting model.

criteria.label: Purpose of Project
criteria.description: Defines and classifies the primary purpose of the project. Maintain-before-build philosophy gives Maintenance equal weight to Security.

subcategories.label: Safety
subcategories.condition: Improvements to existing infrastructure, facilities, equipment that support safety of operations.

subcategories.label: Security
subcategories.condition: Facilities/equipment for secure movement around airport.

subcategories.label: Maintenance
subcategories.condition: Pavement preservation, rehabilitation, NAVAID maintenance, etc. — 'maintain before build'.

subcategories.label: Airport Enhancement
subcategories.condition: New/expanded facilities, capacity, NAVAIDs, building construction.

subcategories.label: Planning
subcategories.condition: Master plans, ALPs, NEPA, special studies.

criteria.label: Project Component
criteria.description: Where on the airport is the project directed. Primary airside facilities prioritized over secondary, then aprons, then taxilanes/landside.

subcategories.label: Airside Primary Runway/Taxiway and Equipment
subcategories.condition: Primary runway, primary taxiway, life-safety equipment.

subcategories.label: Airside Taxilanes, Landside, and Other
subcategories.condition: Taxilanes (other than apron), landside, planning, ops/admin vehicles.

criteria.label: Type of Federal Funding
criteria.description: Wyoming Aeronautics Commission emphasizes matching all federal funding regardless of PRM ranking; this category reflects that priority.

subcategories.label: State Apportionment Funding
subcategories.condition: Annual state apportionment for non-primary federally eligible airports.

criteria.label: Systems Impact
criteria.description: Project's contribution to WySASP state goals, local goals, and Wyoming Aeronautics Commission priorities.

subcategories.label: Achieving or maintaining a WySASP state goal
Achieving or maintaining a WySASP local goal
Achieving or maintaining a Commission priority

criteria.label: Project Timing
criteria.description: Urgency of project completion. Awarded based on Division's professional judgment of sponsor justification.

subcategories.label: Urgent (Division-determined)
subcategories.condition: Emergency repair, regulatory compliance deadline, funding loss risk.

subcategories.label: Group Maintenance
subcategories.condition: Cycle optimization on regularly occurring projects.

criteria.label: Airport Usage
criteria.description: Larger airports benefit more users. Uses WySASP airport classification.

criteria.label: Status of Airport Protection
criteria.description: Land use protections for RPZ and airport influence area. Accumulates across four sub-elements up to a max of 9 points. NOTE: Land Ownership (max 4 pts) is exclusive — only the highest-applicable tier counts. Other sub-elements add independently.

subcategories.label: Airspace and zoning protections in place

governance.approval_process: Sponsors submit pre-applications. Division checks eligibility, then scores each project against the seven categories. Ranked WACIP is presented to the Wyoming Aeronautics Commission, which retains discretion to override the model when collective system needs warrant.

disclaimer: This model encoding is derived from the Wyoming Priority Rating Model for Project Evaluation – 2021. For official adoption use, refer to the source document published by the Wyoming Aeronautics Commission.
